entities.summary: Dima Khatib is a Palestinian journalist, poet and translator. She is the managing director of AJ+, an award-winning digital news service in English, Arabic, French and Spanish launched by Al Jazeera Media Network in San Francisco, USA. She is currently the only female executive director within the Al Jazeera group and one of few female leaders in the Arab media sphere.
